newsitem.title: CANADA: ELAN, Gibson Alberta pipeline starts.
newsitem.headline: ELAN, Gibson Alberta pipeline starts.

text.p: ELAN Energy Inc and Gibson Petroleum Co Ltd said on Tuesday their 54,000 barrel per day ECHO heavy oil pipeline in central Alberta has begun operations.
The 150 km pipeline transports heavy crude to a Gibson terminal at Hardisty, Alberta, from Elk Point, Alberta.
The companies, which each have 50-percent interests, said the pipeline was unique because it was heated, allowing the thick oil to move without condensate.

ECHO, or East Central Heavy Oil, will allow ELAN to deliver its crude oil to the terminal where it can be custom blended to meet specifications on both IPL Energy Inc's pipeline system and the new Express Pipeline to Wyoming from Alberta, ELAN said.

ELAN chief executive Verne Johnson said the line would provide his firm with secure transportation for its production in the Lindberh area, currently at 24,000 barrels per day (18,000 net to the company).
